name: cockpit
description: Live panes and bands for session awareness. Six mods, each toggled in the plugin config. agents-progress: running-subagents and todo bands above the prompt; /agents-info opens the full subagent panel. cache-keeper: cache countdown in the last 5 minutes or when cold, cold-send guard with cost estimate; /keepwarm [90m|2h|off|status] pings to hold the cache, /cache-tax shows its state. context-health: context fill band with warnings, Handoff and Fresh buttons; /ctx-handoff writes .claude/handoff.md and continues in a clean context, /autohandoff [percent|off] does it automatically. usage-limits: always-on session (5h) and weekly (7d) limit bars with reset countdown, pace and a toast at 90%. filetree: /filetree opens a file tree with git status and highlights for files Claude reads, edits and commits. next-steps: three suggested next prompts after each turn; click one to fill the prompt.
